g.text: Data Flow Diagram - Sensor Reading to Alert and Dashboard
Shows how data moves through the system: sensor readings become
tagged telemetry, telemetry becomes processed features, features
become health decisions, and abnormal decisions become alerts.
Processing step in the telemetry-to-alert pipeline
Data store used by dashboard, analytics, or maintenance review
Upstream machine readings from ESP32 to gateway/cloud
Downstream alert or command from cloud/gateway to ESP32
Human acknowledgement and maintenance feedback loop
